basis.note: Printed page 75. All lifts, including platform lifts, which are common in schools. Minimum life expectancy (design requirement) for DfE-funded school buildings. Minimum design requirements placed on contractors for school buildings, not observed replacement ages. Section 5.1.4 (sanitaryware) refers to CIBSE Guide M Appendix 12.A1 'in general'.

open_questions: Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
